## Remittance

Receive unlimited Remittance from abroad to bKash and Cash Out at 7 Taka/thousand from ATM\*

## Money Transfer Service

Remittances from abroad to Bangladesh can be sent easily and securely through authorized and listed banks, money transfer organizations (MTOs), and money exchange houses. Recipients of remittances sent through legal channels will receive a 2.5% government incentive. Also, Cash Out your remittance money at 7 Taka/thousand from ATM\*.

[Learn More](https://www.bkash.com/en/products-services/remittance/money-transfer-service)

![](https://www.bkash.com/images/bkash_grey_thumbnail.svg)

## Remittance Cash Out from ATM

Cash Out your received Remittance at a charge of just 7 Taka per thousand\* from any BRAC Bank, the City Bank and some specific Q-Cash ATM booths by using the bKash App or by dialing \*247# very easily.

[Learn More](https://www.bkash.com/en/products-services/remittance/remittance-cash-out-from-atm)

![](https://www.bkash.com/images/bkash_grey_thumbnail.svg)

## Withdraw Remittance with the Secret Number

Now you can receive remittance sent from abroad with a secret number (MTCN number in case of Western Union and reference number in case of Moneygram) in your bKash account conveniently, instantly and Cash Out from certain ATMs at 7 Taka per thousand only\*!

[Learn More](https://www.bkash.com/en/products-services/remittance/remittance-with-secret-number)

![](https://www.bkash.com/images/bkash_grey_thumbnail.svg)

## Payoneer

Bring your freelancing earnings from Payoneer to bKash super-fast!

Freelancers can easily transfer their freelancing earnings to their bKash account without any paperwork. Customers can open a Payoneer account from ‘Remittance’ section of the bKash app and transfer a minimum of BDT 1,000 to their account and Cash Out from certain ATMs at 7 Taka per thousand only\*. The 2.5% government incentive will not apply to Payoneer.

[Learn More](https://www.bkash.com/en/products-services/remittance/payoneer)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### My phone is showing “Singapore/Malaysia/South Korea prefix for mobile number” OR "Update bKash app to use bKash services. If VPN is enabled on your device, please turn off VPN and try again later" while accessing the app, though I am in Bangladesh. What should I do?

If you are in Bangladesh, but the unable to log in please follow these steps\
1. Ensure there is no VPN running in the background\
2. Please try to log in using mobile data\
3. Ensure Bangladeshi SIM is inserted into the phone\
4. Try closing the app and clear it from the background and restart the app\
5. If the problem still persists, please share your IP and address and ISP name to the bKash customer service channels. \
(Note: you can find your IP, simply by searching "What is my IP address" in google.com, and your ISP name is the name of your Internet service provider which can be found in the internet bill receipt)

### Definitions

a\. bKash Account\
\
   - A virtual storage of money that can be accessed through your mobile phone. After registration, your mobile number will be your bKash Account number.

b\. Open an Account

     - Opening a bKash Account on your mobile phone.  

c\. bKash Mobile Menu\
     - The menu you see after dialing \*247#.

d\. Cash In \
     - Depositing money into your bKash Account.

e\. Cash Out\
   - Withdrawing money from your bKash Account. You can Cash Out from any bKash Agent Point or from BRAC Bank or any Q-Cash ATM.

f\. Send Money\
     - Transferring money from one bKash Account to another bKash Account.

g\. Mobile Recharge\
     - Mobile Recharge service allows you to recharge your Mobile Phone Balance from your bKash Account.

h\. Payment\
    - When you pay from your bKash Account to a seller against a product or service you purchase.

i\. Remittance\
     - Receiving funds from abroad in your bKash Account in Bangladesh.

j\. bKash Mobile Menu PIN\
    - This is a secret number, like a password, that secures your bKash Account.

k\. Security Code\
    - Security Code is a one time PIN. When you Cash Out from the ATM, you need to generate a Security Code which can be used only once and remains valid for 5 minutes.

l\. Transaction ID\
    - A system-generated unique reference number against each transaction that is preserved as identification.

m\. Reference\
    - Mentioning the purpose of the transaction for your own records.

### Can I make transactions 24/7 using bKash?

Yes.

### Do I need to open an Account to use bKash services?

\- Yes, you need to open a bKash Account to use bKash services

### Who can open a bKash Account?

A bKash account can be opened from Bangladesh by-

- Bangladeshi national
- Age 18 years or above
- Having a valid National ID/ Driving License/ Passport
- Currently Robi, Grameenphone, Banglalink, Teletalk and Airtel customers

\
Also, bKash student account can be opened by-

- Bangladeshi national
- Age 14 years to below 18 years (17 years, 11 months and 30 days)
- Having a valid Birth Certificate
- Person whose Mother/ Father has an active bKash Account
- Currently Robi, Grameenphone, Banglalink, Teletalk and Airtel users

\
And bKash account from abroad can be opened by-

- Bangladeshi expatriate national
- Age 18 years or above
- Having a valid national identity card
- Having proof of picture of departure/arrival stamp of your passport
- Valid mobile number of Bangladeshi expatriate in their country of residence

### Is there any charge for opening an Account?

No, opening an Account is completely FREE.
